{{Quote|Merciful Force! Those&hellip;those objects are talking to each other. They're alive&hellip;I think.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Tilotny Throws a Shape" />}}
The '''Bedlam Spirits''' were an omnipotent group of entities that inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]]<ref name="Tilotny Throws a Shape" /> near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> They consisted of [[Tilotny]], [[Horliss-Horliss]], [[Cold Danda Sine]] and [[Splendid Ap]]. The spirits were very powerful beings, capable of manipulating [[Time/Legends|time]] and mass. However, they were prone to childish behavior.<ref name="Tilotny Throws a Shape" />

Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Mission to Bedlam|encountered]] them while escaping from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="Tilotny Throws a Shape" />
